sources.title: An Organizational Second Brain: Building an AI That Learns From Experts
verified_facts: Structured, auditable knowledge architecture separates knowledge from reasoning procedure.
Expert feedback is compiled into verified, regression-tested updates without retraining the underlying model.
Knowledge is distilled into structured files with explicit dependencies and consumers.
Proposed changes undergo independent adversarial review, deterministic structural validation, targeted replay, regression testing, and human review.
Accepted changes are represented as diffs with an audit trail; changes are version-controlled, diffable, and reversible.
sources.claim_ceiling: Institutional knowledge persistence and an architecture compatible with model replacement; not identity continuity.

sources.title: Introducing Muse Spark 1.3
verified_facts: The model is described as sustaining longer-horizon work across multiple workflows in one long thread.
It is described as tracking what it has learned during a task and preserving detailed requirements.
It can work silently in the background.
It is described as confirming before consequential actions and calibrating around irreversible actions.
missing_for_continuity: durable personal state independent of a session
sources.claim_ceiling: Product-level long-horizon and confirmation-gate claims; not durable identity or authority continuity.
